title: Implementing the Cycle of Success: A Case Study

sentences.en: Within Australia, Australian Hotels Inc (AHI) operates nine hotels and employs over 2000 permanent full-time staff, 300 permanent part-time employees and 100 casual staff.
sentences.zh: 在澳大利亚境内,澳大利亚旅馆公司经营9家旅馆,雇用了2000多名长期全职工作人员、300名长期兼职雇员和100名临时工作人员。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: One of its latest ventures, the Sydney Airport hotel (SAH), opened in March 1995.
sentences.zh: 其最近的一个企业,悉尼机场旅馆于1995年3月开业。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The hotel is the closest to Sydney Airport and is designed to provide the best available accommodation, food and beverage and meeting facilities in Sydney’s southern suburbs.
sentences.zh: 旅馆离悉尼机场最近,目的是在悉尼南部郊区提供最佳的住宿、食品和饮料以及会议设施。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Similar to many international hotel chains, however, AHI has experienced difficulties in Australia in providing long-term profits for hotel owners, as a result of the country’s high labour-cost structure.
sentences.zh: 然而,与许多国际旅馆连锁店类似,澳大利亚的AHI由于劳动力成本结构高,在为旅馆业主提供长期利润方面遇到困难。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In order to develop an economically viable hotel organisation model, AHI decided to implement some new policies and practices at SAH.
sentences.zh: 为了发展经济上可行的旅馆组织模式,国际住房协会决定在SAH实施一些新的政策和做法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The first of the initiatives was an organisational structure with only three levels of management – compared to the traditional seven.
sentences.zh: 第一项倡议是一个组织结构,只有三级管理,而传统的七级管理则不同。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Partly as a result of this change, there are 25 per cent fewer management positions, enabling a significant saving.
sentences.zh: 部分由于这一变化,管理职位减少了25%,从而节省了大量资金。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: This change also has other implications.
sentences.zh: 这一变化还涉及其他影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Communication, both up and down the organisation, has greatly improved.
sentences.zh: 本组织的上下沟通都大有改进。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Decision-making has been forced down in many cases to front-line employees.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下,决策被迫由一线雇员作出。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: As a result, guest requests are usually met without reference to a supervisor, improving both customer and employee satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 因此,满足客人的要求通常不请上级人员,从而既提高了客户满意度,也提高了雇员满意度。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The hotel also recognised that it would need a different approach to selecting employees who would fit in with its new policies.
sentences.zh: 旅馆还认识到,它需要采取一种不同的方法来选择符合其新政策的雇员。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In its advertisements, the hotel stated a preference for people with some ‘service’ experience in order to minimise traditional work practices being introduced into the hotel.
sentences.zh: 该旅馆在其广告中表示,偏向于具有某种 " 服务 " 经验的人,以便尽量减少旅馆采用的传统工作做法。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Over 7000 applicants filled in application forms for the 120 jobs initially offered at SAH.
sentences.zh: 超过7 000名申请人在申请表上填写了最初在高级文职办事处提供的120个工作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The balance of the positions at the hotel (30 management and 40 shift leader positions) were predominantly filled by transfers from other AHI properties.
sentences.zh: 旅馆的其余职位(30个管理层和40个轮班领导职位)主要通过调出其他AHI房产来填补。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A series of tests and interviews were conducted with potential employees, which eventually left 280 applicants competing for the 120 advertised positions.
sentences.zh: 对潜在雇员进行了一系列测试和访谈,最终有280名申请人竞争120个已公布职位。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: After the final interview, potential recruits were divided into three categories.
sentences.zh: 在最后面谈之后,可能的新兵分为三类。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Category A was for applicants exhibiting strong leadership qualities, Category C was for applicants perceived to be followers, and Category B was for applicants with both leader and follower qualities.
sentences.zh: A类是具有很强领导素质的申请人,C类是被认为追随者的申请人,B类是具有领导和追随素质的申请人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Department heads and shift leaders then composed prospective teams using a combination of people from all three categories.
sentences.zh: 然后,由所有三类人员组成未来小组。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Once suitable teams were formed, offers of employment were made to team members.
sentences.zh: 一旦组建了合适的小组,便向小组成员提供就业机会。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Another major initiative by SAH was to adopt a totally multi-skilled workforce.
sentences.zh: SAH的另一个重大倡议是采用完全由多技能人员组成的劳动力队伍。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Although there may be some limitations with highly technical jobs such as cooking or maintenance, wherever possible, employees at SAH are able to work in a wide variety of positions.
sentences.zh: 尽管在烹饪或维修等高技术工作方面可能存在一些限制,但在可能的情况下,特别安全厅的雇员能够从事各种各样的工作。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A multi-skilled workforce provides far greater management flexibility during peak and quiet times to transfer employees to needed positions.
sentences.zh: 一支多技能劳动力队伍在高峰和平静时期提供更大的管理灵活性,将雇员调到所需职位。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For example, when office staff are away on holidays during quiet period of the year, employees in either food or beverage or housekeeping departments can temporarily fill in.
sentences.zh: 例如,当办公室工作人员在一年的安静期间休假时,食品或饮料或家务部门的雇员可以临时补足。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The most crucial way, however, of improving the labour cost structure at SAH was to find better, more productive ways of providing customer service.
sentences.zh: 然而,改善特别自助机构的劳动力成本结构的最重要方式是找到提供客户服务的更好、更有成效的方式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: SAH management concluded this would first require a process of ‘benchmarking’.
sentences.zh: SAH管理层认为,这首先需要 " 基准确定 " 程序。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The prime objective of the benchmarking process was to compare a range of service delivery processes across a range of criteria using teams made up of employees from different departments within the hotel which interacted with each other.
sentences.zh: 基准制定过程的主要目标是,利用由旅馆内不同部门的雇员组成的小组,对一系列标准范围内的服务提供程序进行比较,这些小组由旅馆内相互交往的各部门的雇员组成。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This process resulted in performance measures that greatly enhanced SAH’s ability to improve productivity and quality.
sentences.zh: 这一过程产生了业绩计量,大大加强了SAH提高生产率和质量的能力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The front office team discovered through this project that a high proportion of AHI Club member reservations were incomplete.
sentences.zh: 前沿办公室小组通过该项目发现,AHI俱乐部成员预订的很大一部分未完成。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: As a result, the service provided to these guests was below the standard promised to them as part of their membership agreement.
sentences.zh: 因此,向这些客人提供的服务低于作为其成员协定的一部分向他们承诺的标准。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Reducing the number of incomplete reservations greatly improved guest perceptions of service.
sentences.zh: 减少不完整的预订数目,大大改善了客人对服务的看法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: In addition, a program modelled on an earlier project called ‘Take Charge’ was implemented.
sentences.zh: 此外,还执行了一个仿照早先称为 " 代罪 " 项目的方案。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Essentially, Take Charge provides an effective feedback loop from both customers and employees.
sentences.zh: 基本上,“接管”是客户和雇员的有效反馈循环。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Customer comments, both positive and negative, are recorded by staff.
sentences.zh: 工作人员记录客户的正面和负面意见。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: These are collated regularly to identify opportunities for improvement.
sentences.zh: 定期对这些清单进行整理,以查明改进的机会。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Just as importantly, employees are requested to note down their own suggestions for improvement.
sentences.zh: 同样重要的是,要求雇员注意自己提出的改进建议。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: (AHI has set an expectation that employees will submit at least three suggestions for every one they receive from a customer.)
sentences.zh: (AHI规定,雇员每收到客户的建议,至少要提交三份建议。 )

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Employee feedback is reviewed daily and suggestions are implemented within 48 hours, if possible, or a valid reason is given for non-implementation.
sentences.zh: 雇员的反馈每天接受审查,建议在48小时内执行,如有可能,或提出不执行的正当理由。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: If suggestions require analysis or data collection, the Take Charge team has 30 days in which to address the issue and come up with recommendations.
sentences.zh: 如果建议需要分析或数据收集,接受费用小组有30天时间处理这一问题并提出建议。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Although quantitative evidence of AHI’s initiatives at SAH are limited at present, anecdotal evidence clearly suggests that these practices are working.
sentences.zh: 虽然目前有关AHI在SAH倡议的定量证据有限,但传闻证据清楚地表明,这些做法正在起作用。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Indeed AHI is progressively rolling out these initiatives in other hotels in Australia, whilst numerous overseas visitors have come to see how the program works.
sentences.zh: 事实上,澳大利亚国际服务社正在澳大利亚其他旅馆逐步推出这些举措,而许多海外游客也来看这个方案如何运作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
